cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a space-station docking bay with a sleek shuttle on its pad and long light strips — perched on a ledge or edge; an ice palace hall of carved crystal pillars — perched on a ledge or edge; a traditional archery ground beside a temple wall — holds her keepsake up beside her face; a small independent riverside cinema lobby with old film reels and an unlettered ticket stand — she dresses as a retro cinema usher for a themed evening; a modern canal-side bakery terrace at blue hour — she pauses to break a warm pull-apart bun into two portions; a riverside cycle path with a parked bicycle — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a starship observation deck with a vast curved window onto a nebula — standing; the cushioned foredeck of a moored yacht — chest-deep in the water; a mountain lodge with a front counter and a fireplace — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a hydroponic bathing pool aboard a starship — chest-deep in the water; a Three Kingdoms film-set street — holds a gourd-shaped wine flask on a red cord by its cord at chest height; a vast fantasy library of towering shelves — lifts a small hand lantern to chest height; a fashion runway under white spotlights — sitting on the ground
